vocals.source: anvuew vocal dereverb BS-RoFormer on MUSDB18-HQ train vocal stems, 20 s vocal-active excerpts
vocals.note: high_db is 0 dB (reverb as loud as the voice) rather than the corpus p90 (-1.3): produced vocals and over-wet vocals overlap, so auto mode only acts on clear cases. Readings above max_credible_db mean the stem is not a voice the meter understands.
